scripts.setup: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.dev: start npm run backend && npm run web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix frontend && npm run typecheck --prefix backend
scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.validate:web: cd frontend && npx expo export --platform web
scripts.db:test: npm run db:test:fresh && npm run db:test:upgrade
